content.comment_body: Hello, I wasn't aware of the limitation and ended up ordering a [article_no] module online. Returning it would be too costly, so I'm trying to make the most of it. My main question: Is there any way to use it for web access? Ideally, I'd like to view input/output statuses and program variables remotely, for example via an Android phone to control a heating process. Is that possible? I would also like to adjust settings such as room temperature remotely, similar to teleservice. Is it possible to do this with the official app from [company_name]? [url] Or are there any alternative approaches? I feel [company_name] should clarify that not all modules with [article_no] have web capabilities. It's frustrating to discover these limitations after purchase. Thank you ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from discussion about [product_name] compatibility with the web editor.

Hello [user_name], Since the introduction of the [product_name] with [article_no], it's equipped with a basic web server. Through this web server, you can display what appears on the module's display or on an operator device. There is also some limited control available via the web server. Only the latest [product_name] with [version_no] models support an enhanced web server, allowing you to create custom pages. Yes, you can use the official app with this module.

This is good news—I'm relieved! So, as I understand it, I can use a built-in standard web page (but not design my own)? This page will show me what's on the module's display? Can you advise on settings or steps needed to use it? I'd appreciate a pointer to a tutorial so I can get started. Thanks in advance.

That's correct—there is a standard web page. The web server displays message texts. You can use cursor and function keys from the operator device through the web server. When creating message texts, ensure you enable both the display and web server options. I've attached a screen recording for reference.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was initially frustrated due to unclear distinctions in web capabilities among [product_name] modules with [article_no], especially regarding remote access and control through mobile devices. Responses clarified that a basic web server is included for limited monitoring and control, and that the official app is compatible. There's an identified need for clearer communication about module feature differences.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to remotely monitor and control module variables through standard or custom web interfaces and adjust parameters with an Android device. There is also a desire for clear product documentation outlining web features to help make informed purchasing decisions.
